summary: Cache utilities module (ES module named exports). It provides localStorage helpers that store values wrapped as JSON `{ timestamp, value }` (`setLocalStorageCache`, `getLocalStorageCache`, `removeLocalStorageCache`, `getLocalStorageInfo`) and an in-memory `memoryCache` object (backed by a closure map) with `set`, `get`, `remove` and `getInfo` methods using the same timestamped record shape.

exports.setLocalStorageCache: setLocalStorageCache(key, value) — stores a timestamped JSON record in localStorage
exports.getLocalStorageCache: getLocalStorageCache(key) — returns the stored value or null
exports.getLocalStorageInfo: getLocalStorageInfo(key) — returns the parsed { timestamp, value } record
exports.memoryCache: in-memory cache object { set, get, remove, getInfo }
